title: Spec’ing your next truck: matching truck to route the right way
description: Engine, transmission, axle ratio and sleeper size should all follow the work. A quick guide to getting the spec right before you sign.
body:
The right truck for a regional food route is the wrong truck for heavy-haul or vocational work. Spec’ing starts with how the truck will earn its money.

Start with the load and the route

Gross weight, terrain and average speed decide engine rating and axle ratio. Get those right and fuel economy and component life follow.

Think about the driver

Sleeper size, visibility and cab comfort matter for retention. A truck drivers want to drive is a truck that stays staffed.

Our sales team can walk you through spec options on in-stock units and factory orders.
